memory_update.text: FARM is the purest but riskiest public micro-cap for B2B restaurant/hospitality coffee DSD exposure; treat as speculative until liquidity, debt, customer concentration, and margin pass-through are verified.

WEST is the strongest underfollowed small-cap platform candidate for integrated coffee, tea, extracts, RTD, and private-label beverage solutions across foodservice, restaurant, convenience, and hospitality customers.

THS is a less pure but scaled private-label coffee manufacturer after acquiring Farmer Brothers' Northlake facility and direct-ship coffee business; screen it as a second-order private-label coffee beneficiary.

The key chokepoint variables for B2B coffee suppliers are not just restaurant demand; they are green-coffee commodity inflation, tariff/import exposure, pass-through timing, DSD route density, customer concentration, facility utilization, and debt/capex burden.
Need primary filings for current segment revenue, gross margin, customer concentration, debt, and commodity pass-through for FARM, WEST, THS, and SJM before any Layer 2 ranking.
